[[Vanquisher|Vanquish]] the [[Forum Highlands]]. 

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Clear the Forum Highlands in [[Vabbi]] of all enemies in [[hard mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 10,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,500 [[Gold]]
* 3,500 [[Sunspear rank|Sunspear Promotion Point]]s
* Complete the Base Objective for 150 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].

== Dialogues ==
=== Initial dialogue ===
; [[Zaishen Vanquish]]
: ''"Clear the Forum Highlands in Vabbi of all enemies in hard mode."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I can do that!
|decline = No, I'm way too busy today.
|ask = There are still threats that remain. Return when you have slain all of the foes that await you at your destination.}}

=== Reward dialogue ===
; Zehnchu
: ''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''

== Notes ==
* Unlike other Zaishen Vanquish quests that require vanquishing areas in Vabbi, this quest awards 3,500 Sunspear Promotion Points instead of 750.
